audit-room.summary: Audit Data Room health - gaps, drift, evidence tier, decision quality.
audit-room.sentence: When my room has grown and I am not sure it still holds together, I want to check it for gaps, drift, weak evidence and shaky decisions, so I can fix the weak spots before I build on them.

slots.when: my room has grown and I am not sure it still holds together
slots.want: to check it for gaps, drift, weak evidence and shaky decisions
slots.so: fix the weak spots before I build on them

build.summary: Build or extend the room or the method surface itself - start a room, add a method.
build.sentence: When my work needs a room or a method that does not exist yet, I want to create it, so I can work inside a structure that fits my venture.

slots.when: my work needs a room or a method that does not exist yet
slots.want: to create it
slots.so: work inside a structure that fits my venture

compare-options.summary: Compare alternatives across criteria - choose between A/B/C.
compare-options.sentence: When I have several options in front of me and must pick one, I want to compare them against the same criteria, so I can choose with the trade-offs in plain view.

slots.when: I have several options in front of me and must pick one
slots.want: to compare them against the same criteria

connect-domains.summary: Find cross-domain analogues - what does this look like in another field?

slots.when: my thinking is stuck inside my own field

decide-pursue.sentence: When an opportunity is in front of me and pursuing it would cost me months, I want to judge whether it is worth pursuing, so I can commit to it or let it go with a clear reason.

slots.when: an opportunity is in front of me and pursuing it would cost me months
